features: Elegant Comfort King-size mattress protector dimensions: (78 in x 80 in) -Fitted Sheet Style; Stretchable skirt fits any deep pocket mattresses up to 16" - Thickness, softness and warmth, stronger and durable with the strongest stitching to prevent tears Deep-pocket, fully elasticized fitted sheet for mattresses up to 16 inch thick

Elegant Comfort DESIGN AND MATERIALS. We use natural high quality materials – Super soft, pleasant to touch Bamboo fabric (40% Bamboo, 60% Polyester Blend surface) along with a waterproof breathable membrane. The edge on elastic fitted side made of polyester, which perfectly fits the mattress. Noiseless and comfortable. Cooling ultra-tech polyester and viscose rayon derived from bamboo blends to keep you comfortable throughout the night
IMPROVE YOUR QUALITY OF LIFE : The Bamboo mattress protector is Breathable Cool Flow Technology safe for your health (vinyl free). Indispensable for those who have children or pets.

EASY TO CLEAN, USE & FIT: Bamboo mattress protector requires cleaning at least once every 3 months (machine wash according to the instructions on the package). This mattress cover is easy to put on, and convenient to use. DURABLE & EASY to CLEAN- Machine wash & dry - For frequent accidents, buy 2 or more - while one is washed, the other protects the mattress
Elegant Comfort SOFT & NOISELESS - 100% Waterproof Bamboo surface; Wicks away moisture; Retains the feel of your mattress - Free from Vinyl, PVC, Phthalates, fire retardants and other toxic chemicals
description: You love your mattress. It's soft and comfortable, and it feels like sleeping on a cloud (or at least that's your best guess, seeing as how you've never actually slept on a cloud). This 100% Waterproof Bamboo Mattress Protector keeps your mattress protected, leaving you breathing easy and sleeping comfortably. This cover fits extra-thick mattresses deep pockets up to 16" , water resistant, and serves as a barrier to nasty NULLs, keeping you and your mattress safe. All Sizes Available: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King and California King
